# Reliability Checklist: Claude/Codex Cutover and Universal Install Release Gate

**Purpose**: Validate that XPLAT-008 reliability requirements define native interpreter discovery, update, doctor, autoheal, UAT, and safe failure outcomes clearly enough for release-gate implementation.
**Created**: 2026-07-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist reliability` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Interpreter Discovery And Invocation

- [x] CHK001 Is interpreter discovery specified for native Windows, macOS, and Linux with platform-specific candidate order and Python `>=3.11` acceptance criteria? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications Session 1/3, Plan Technical Decisions, Runner Invocation Contract]
- [x] CHK002 Are active installed-runtime requirements clear that runner invocation uses argv `[resolved_python, "-m", "speckit_pro_runner"]` without shell parsing, redirection, `jq`, or shell fallback? [Clarity, Spec FR-002/FR-003, Plan Constraints, Runner Invocation Contract]
- [x] CHK003 Are failure diagnostics required to include attempted candidates, resolved executable when present, version, platform/cache context, failure code, stderr or diagnostic text, and exact remediation? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications Session 3, Research Decision 3, Data Model InterpreterResolutionRecord]
- [x] CHK004 Are stdin, stdout, and stderr requirements consistent across the spec, plan, data model, and runner invocation contract? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications Session 1, Plan Constraints, Data Model RunnerInvocationRecord, Runner Invocation Contract]

## Update, Doctor, And Autoheal Outcomes

- [x] CHK005 Are doctor, update, and autoheal operations included in the installed-runtime operation model and tied to release-critical behavior? [Completeness, Spec US3/FR-015/FR-018, Data Model RunnerInvocationRecord, Runner Invocation Contract]
- [x] CHK006 Is stale or incomplete installed-plugin detection required before meaningful workflow execution continues? [Coverage, Spec FR-015, Plan Slice 3, Release Readiness Contract]
- [x] CHK007 Is safe autoheal limited with objective criteria for expected path, trusted source identity, version or release channel, and checksum-backed integrity? [Clarity, Spec FR-016, Research Decision 8, Data Model InstallHealthFinding, Install Health Repair Contract]
- [x] CHK008 Are unsafe install gaps required to stop broad automatic reinstall or wipe-copy behavior and produce exact manual remediation steps? [Clarity, Spec FR-017, Data Model RepairAction, Install Health Repair Contract]
- [x] CHK009 Are trusted and unsafe install-health classifications complete enough to distinguish trusted missing/stale artifacts from unknown, extra, mismatched, trust-root, and out-of-cache drift? [Coverage, Spec Clarifications Session 3, Data Model InstallHealthFinding, Install Health Repair Contract]
- [x] CHK010 Are repair action outcomes measurable for autoheal completion, blocked manual remediation, digest verification, user-facing messages, and manual steps? [Measurability, Spec SC-006, Data Model RepairAction, Install Health Repair Contract]

## Native UAT Coverage

- [x] CHK011 Are exactly six required platform/product UAT rows specified for Claude and Codex on Windows, macOS, and Linux? [Completeness, Spec FR-012, Research Decision 7, UAT Matrix Contract]
- [x] CHK012 Are install, bundled-agent verification, first use, scaffold/status, autopilot dry-run, latest-tag update, and incomplete-install repair all required for every UAT row? [Completeness, Spec FR-013, Spec SC-004, Plan Slice 3, UAT Matrix Contract]
- [x] CHK013 Are UAT evidence fields measurable and reviewer-readable, including operator/date, host version, installed cache path, interpreter resolution, expected result, actual result, evidence link, notes, and pass/fail status? [Measurability, Spec Clarifications Session 3, Data Model NativeUATRow, UAT Matrix Contract]
- [x] CHK014 Are release-readiness failure conditions specified for missing rows, placeholder-only rows, smoke-only evidence, failing rows, empty expected or actual results, raw HTML anchors, missing evidence links, and unsupported public claims? [Measurability, Spec FR-014, Spec Clarifications Session 3, Data Model NativeUATRow, UAT Matrix Contract]
- [x] CHK015 Are native support claims constrained to platform/product rows with completed passing UAT evidence? [Consistency, Spec SC-007, Research Decision 9, Release Readiness Contract]

## Release Blocking And Traceability

- [x] CHK016 Are release-readiness blocker classes defined for update proof, install-health repair evidence, incomplete UAT, unsafe repair claims, and active shell runtime dependencies? [Completeness, Spec FR-019, Research Decision 6, Release Readiness Contract]

- [x] CHK018 Are stale or incomplete installs that cannot be safely autohealed handled as manual remediation rather than treated as release-ready success? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, Spec Clarifications Session 3, Install Health Repair Contract]
- [x] CHK019 Are reliability-critical requirements and success criteria traceable to changed files and verification evidence in the PR packet? [Traceability, Spec FR-020/SC-008, Plan PR Review Packet Source, Release Readiness Contract]
